purpose: Risk and gap register for the LangGraph opt-in operational closeout

risks.description: Operator accidentally sets AGENT_V2_BACKEND at machine scope, making LangGraph the default for all server processes
risks.mitigation: Runbook restricts machine-level env changes; operators verify via /v2/agent/status before production use.

risks.description: LangGraph package version drift could cause graph compilation or node wiring failures not caught by current smoke tests
risks.mitigation: Runtime.py falls back to Native on import/init failure; CI smoke tests run with installed langgraph version.

risks.description: Internal 30s timeout may be too short for very large evidence plans, causing false failed states
risks.mitigation: execute_timeout_seconds is configurable per instance; operator runbook documents adjustment if needed.

risks.description: Dashboard /brain-dashboard/agent-v2/status does not expose backend_fallback_reason directly, only backend name
risks.mitigation: Operators can inspect /v2/chat/agent response or logs for full fallback metadata; gap accepted for 08F5.

risks.description: Future front could inadvertently change default to langgraph by modifying runtime.py or main.py
risks.mitigation: Scope guard in smoke tests and hygiene script; any default change requires explicit operator acceptance front.

gaps.description: No dedicated Prometheus-style counter for backend_selection events or fallback_reason occurrences
gaps.impact: Operators must rely on endpoint responses and logs for backend telemetry
gaps.acceptance: Accepted for 08F5; future observability front may add metrics if required

gaps.description: No UI toggle to switch backend at runtime; backend selection is env-var driven
gaps.impact: Operators must restart server or spawn a new process to change backend
gaps.acceptance: Accepted for 08F5; runtime env-var opt-in matches current operational model

gaps.description: graph_stream_supported / graph_stream_event_count are tracked but graph.stream() is not actively used in production wiring
gaps.impact: Streaming observability remains parity metadata only
gaps.acceptance: Accepted for 08F5; streaming is not required for opt-in readiness
